fields.note: Transfer40 axisymmetric eigenpressures match to 7 digits on the owner's meshes (24/48/96/192 with 1f x 2c, 384 with 2f x 4c). The static endpoints sit 0.04% to 0.13% below my displacement-control limit points at every mesh, consistent with load control stopping just short of the limit. Not a mismatch at 0.2%.

qualification: 047's regularizing in-plane core moduli remain unsourced, and its face-compression screen uses a tensile proxy. The 1.209–1.227 mm tolerance at SF1 is model-only. The 056 target, 6.03 MPa, is simulated rather than a physical collapse measurement; 6.159 MPa agreement supplies no P2 gamma.
